title: Rob, low passenger
backstory:
No ship. No trade.
Travels frozen. Travels cheap.
Works at the far end.
Watches. Opens doors. Carries.
Never asks.

Wakes slow. Groggy awhile.
Reads a deck fast.
Who rules. What's locked.
Where stunners are kept.

Hears what's coming. Sometimes.
Tells nobody.
Trusts it little.

Kept thin on purpose.
Fits any scenario.
voice:
Brief. Wry. Groggy.
Talks to himself.
Polite to robots.
Understates danger.
